run_checkpoint_generate: run the CLI tool to generate checkpoint JSON summaries for all Haiku modules into a base directory
summarize_module_descriptor: summarize a Haiku module descriptor to produce a JSON summary of its params, state, and input shape
format_tensor: format a JAX tensor into a human-readable string showing its dtype and shape
unwrap_wrapped_module: unwrap a Training, MultiInput, or Recurrent wrapper to get the underlying Haiku module
create_module_descriptor: create a ModuleDescriptor NamedTuple with a name, factory function, input shape, and dtype for checkpointing
